body.p: Without prejudice, this listing of the claims replaces all prior versions and listings of the claims in the present application:
Reply to Office Action of June 3, 2024

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A method for operating a transverse stabilization system of a vehicle, the method comprising the following steps:
reading in a steering direction of the vehicle and a setpoint direction of the vehicle;
determining, based on a comparison of the steering and setpoint directions to each other, that there is satisfaction of a condition that there is greater than a threshold deviation between steering and setpoint directions, indicating that a steering being performed is towards a first target point that is different than a second target point to which the setpoint direction is to lead;and determining responsive to the satisfaction of the condition, performing the following:setting a transverse stabilization direction that is different than the steering direction and the setpoint direction, the transverse stabilization direction being towards a third target for point that is different than each of the first and second target points; and
performing a transverse stabilization automatically system using the steering the vehicle in direction and the setpoint transverse stabilization direction.
2. (Currently Amended) The method as recited in claim 1, wherein the transverse stabilization direction target is determined as lying between the setpoint direction and the steering direction.
3. (Currently Amended) The method as recited in claim 1, wherein, in the setting determining of the transverse stabilization target direction is performed such that,a degree, relative to the steering direction, to which the setpoint direction factors into the setting of the transverse stabilization is such that the greater weighted dependent on a deviation between the setpoint direction and the steering direction is, the greater is the degree to which the setpoint direction factors into the setting.
4. (Canceled).
Reply to Office Action of June 3, 2024
5. (Currently Amended) The method as recited in claim 1, wherein the setpoint direction is used for the setting of to determine the transverse stabilization target conditional upon that when a confidence value of the setpoint direction is greater than a predetermined threshold value.
6. (Original) The method as recited in claim 1, wherein the setpoint direction is derived from a recognized line of the road.
7. (Original) The method as recited in claim 1, wherein the setpoint direction is determined using an environment capture system of the vehicle.
8. (Currently Amended) The method as recited in claim 1, wherein the setpoint direction is derived from a [[n]] setpoint trajectory for the vehicle.
9. (Currently Amended) A control unit for a transverse stabilization system, the control unit configured to:
read in a steering direction of the vehicle and a setpoint direction of the vehicle;
determine, based on a comparison of the steering and setpoint directions to each other, that there is satisfaction of a condition that there is greater than a threshold deviation between steering and setpoint directions, indicating that a steering being performed is towards a first target point that is different than a second target point to which the setpoint direction is to lead;and determine responsive to the satisfaction of the condition, performing the following:set a transverse stabilization direction that is different than the steering direction and the setpoint direction, the transverse stabilization direction being towards a third target for pointthat is different than each of the first and second target points; and
perform a transverse stabilization automatically system using the steering the vehicle in direction and the setpoint transverse stabilization direction.

performing a transverse stabilization automatically system using the steering the vehicle in direction and the setpoint transverse stabilization direction.
